CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.registration_has_active_owner()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
    SELECT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships
      WHERE role = 'owner' AND status = 'active'
    );
  $function$
